Choice slots (code null in source) carry the official option text in choice_note and parsed course options in options; prerequisite references to option courses not placed in-plan are listed in external_prereqs per the collection rule.

Program description (from official map): The Bachelor of Science with a Major in Integrated Health Science will provide a broad-based interdisciplinary degree designed for students interested in pursuing a career in healthcare. To do so, the IHS major will consist of a core group of classes grounded in the basic natural, social and health sciences with a thread of interprofessional education (IPE) and healthcare innovation woven throughout.
